content_sections.heading: EPI Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: EPI has announced 12 vacancies at different locations across India. The post-wise and location-wise vacancy details are given below.

content_sections.heading: EPI Manager Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification, post-qualification experience and previous remuneration for the post. The qualification must be recognised by AICTE, UGC or another competent statutory authority. Important: Teaching, training, consultancy and freelancing experience will not be treated as relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: EPI Previous Remuneration Requirement
content_sections.text: In addition to the prescribed qualification and experience, candidates must meet the following previous gross remuneration requirement: Candidates must produce supporting documents such as salary slips, bank statements, Form 16 or a salary certificate. The last three months' salary slips must be produced during document verification.

content_sections.heading: EPI Salary 2026
content_sections.text: House Rent Allowance according to the place of posting Provident Fund benefits under the Employees' Provident Funds Act, 1952 Reimbursement of self-medical insurance premium up to Rs.3,000 per year Gratuity, as admissible Annual increment of 3%, subject to satisfactory performance Location-based compensatory allowance for eligible postings in the North East Region

content_sections.heading: EPI Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit ranges from 32 to 42 years, depending on the post and reserved category. Age will be calculated as of 29 September 2026. SC and ST candidates: 5 years OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates: 3 years Persons with Disabilities: 10 years Age relaxation will apply to the reserved posts according to Government rules. Reserved-category candidates applying against an unreserved post will not receive category-based age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: EPI Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee.

content_sections.heading: EPI Contract Period
content_sections.text: The appointment will initially be made for one year. It may be extended up to three years based on satisfactory performance and organisational requirements.

content_sections.heading: EPI Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their educational qualification marks and relevant post-qualification experience. Initial scrutiny of online applications Shortlisting based on qualification and experience Written test, if required Personal interview Document verification If EPI receives a large number of applications, it may conduct a written test for screening candidates. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. Corporate Office, New Delhi Western Regional Office, Mumbai Project Coordination Office, Bhubaneswar Southern Regional Office, Chennai The interview date, venue and reporting time will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through email.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for EPI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates called for the interview must produce the following original documents along with one set of self-attested copies: System-generated online application form Updated resume or bio-data Class 10 certificate as proof of date of birth Class 10 and Class 12 mark sheets and certificates Graduation and postgraduate mark sheets and certificates Professional qualification certificates, if applicable Post-qualification experience certificates Appointment, joining and relieving orders, where applicable Pay slips, Form 16 or other remuneration proof SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS, PwD or Ex-Serviceman certificate, if applicable Aadhaar card, PAN card, voter ID or passport One recent passport-size colour photograph Any other relevant supporting document

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for EPI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Photograph and signature requirements: The scanned photograph and signature must be in JPEG format and should not exceed 60 KB each. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in EPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: EPI has announced 12 vacancies for Assistant Manager, Manager Grade-II, Manager Grade-I and Senior Manager posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for EPI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 29 September 2026 at 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Depending on the post, candidates must possess CA, ICWA, MBA Finance, BE, B.Tech, AMIE or an equivalent recognised qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for EPI Manager posts?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration ranges from Rs.40,000 to Rs.70,000 per month plus applicable House Rent Allowance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit ranges from 32 to 42 years, depending on the post and reservation category.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on qualification and experience and called for an interview. EPI may conduct a written test if required.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent appointment?
faq.answer: No. The appointment will initially be made on a fixed-term contract for one year, which may be extended up to three years.

faq.question: Q8. Can applications be submitted through email?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must apply through the online application facility available on the EPI website.
